request.query: nonempty right neighborhood filter eventual conjunction exists witness

items.name: Filter.Eventually.exists
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {f : Filter α} [f.NeBot], (∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x) → ∃ x, p x

items.name: Filter.Eventually.and
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {p q : α → Prop} {f : Filter α},
  Filter.Eventually p f → Filter.Eventually q f → ∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x ∧ q x

items.name: Filter.Eventually.exists_mem
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {p : α → Prop} {f : Filter α}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x) → ∃ v ∈ f, ∀ y ∈ v, p y

items.name: eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall
items.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {p : X → Prop},
  (∀ᶠ (x : X) in nhdsSet s, p x) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ᶠ (y : X) in nhds x, p y

items.name: Filter.Frequently.and_eventually
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {p q : α → Prop} {f : Filter α},
  (∃ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x) → (∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, q x) → ∃ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x ∧ q x

items.name: Filter.eventually_and
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {p q : α → Prop} {f : Filter α},
  (∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x ∧ q x) ↔ (∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, p x) ∧ ∀ᶠ (x : α) in f, q x
